name: Tortilla Chips with Homemade Pico de Gallo, Guacamole & Black Bean Dip

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE BLACK BEAN DIP:                                                                                                                                                                             


Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
jalapeño pepper
lime
⅓ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl.
Preheat a skillet over medium heat.

While the skillet heats up, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Small dice and add to the bowl with the onion and garlic. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add jalapeño, onion, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, juice lime into a blender.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the blender with the lime along with water and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) can black beans
2 tbsp water
½ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the jalapeño mixture is soft, add to the blender. Blend on high, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time if needed, until smooth.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the blender and process once more until just combined. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.

FOR THE PICO DE GALLO:

Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
lime
jalapeño pepper
⅓ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice lime into a small bowl.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince shallot and garlic. Add both to the bowl, along with salt, and stir to combine the pico de gallo. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 shallot
1 clove garlic
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE GUACAMOLE:

Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice lime into a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lime juice.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and add to the bowl. Season with spices and mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: TO SERVE: Place chips in a large bowl and serve with dips on the side. Enjoy!
